name: The Algarve
mandate: PrompTugal.news The Algarve: AI and technology across the Algarve and its 17 towns, centred on Faro's university and innovation community and on tourism and health, and what reaches the region from Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: The Algarve's AI activity is concentrated in Faro around the University of Algarve and Algarve Evolution, and is aimed mostly at the two big regional sectors, tourism and health, with the university adding heritage, food and marine research. Regional bodies such as CCDR Algarve, NERA and Turismo do Algarve fund and teach AI adoption, and in 2026 the University won 31.5 million euros for an AI-first heritage centre.

sources.title: UAlg wins 31.5 million euros for UAlgTec Heritage
Funds to bring AI and robotics to 15 tourism firms

look.landmark: Ponta da Piedade and the Faro lagoon
look.motif: Atlantic blue, limestone cliffs, a university on the lagoon

ai_news.title: NERA hosts a Lunch & Learn on AI tools for customer analysis, at the University of Algarve
ai_news.summary: The regional business association NERA hosted a session at CRIA, the University of Algarve's entrepreneurship division in Faro, on using AI tools to turn customer feedback into business decisions. It ran on 10 November under the INTREPIDA pro cross-border project.
ai_news.ai_path: The session is about using AI tools to analyse customer opinions.
ai_news.significance_why: A Faro session, but run by a project that serves women-led firms across the Algarve.

ai_news.title: DevFest Faro gives two days to building AI agents in practice
ai_news.summary: Google Developer Groups Faro runs a free two-day conference on 27 and 28 November at the University of Algarve's Penha campus, on building, securing and scaling AI applications and agents with Google Gemini and Google Cloud. Algarve Evolution is a partner.
ai_news.ai_path: The conference is about building and securing AI-powered applications and agents.
ai_news.significance_why: An open two-day AI conference that draws students and professionals from the whole region.

ai_news.title: UAlg's arts and communication centre opens INTERFACE, a digital translation lab, with an AI Studio
ai_news.summary: The University of Algarve's CIAC opened the INTERFACE lab at the Penha campus on 9 October to turn complex science into visual and immersive content, backed by 473,800 euros from FCT's EQUIPAR+2 under the PRR. Its AI Studio extension, focused on AI and digital literacy, sits at CIAC's hub in Santarém, outside the Algarve.
ai_news.ai_path: A UAlg lab has an AI and digital literacy studio as part of the project.
ai_news.significance_why: A Faro lab, with its AI studio outside the Algarve.

ai_news.title: Algarve Evolution opens a survey on how local companies adopt AI
ai_news.summary: Algarve Evolution launched the Algarve Business AI Adoption Survey, a five-minute questionnaire on how firms of any size use AI, what blocks them and where they see opportunity. Answers are reported only in aggregate and the survey is to repeat twice a year to shape regional support and training.
ai_news.ai_path: The survey measures AI adoption by regional businesses.
ai_news.significance_why: A survey of every business in the Algarve.

ai_news.title: University of Algarve launches its AI use policy
ai_news.summary: The university published its policy on the use of AI, including generative AI: a humanist, critical and responsible approach with guidance for students, teaching staff, researchers and administrative services, drawing on European Commission, UNESCO, OECD and SEA-EU references. An April 2026 draft had gone to consultation until 8 May.
ai_news.ai_path: A university sets the rules for AI use across teaching, research and administration.
ai_news.significance_why: The region's university sets AI rules for its students and staff in Faro and Portimão.

ai_news.title: ULS Algarve holds a webinar on AI in the national health service
ai_news.summary: The Algarve's local health unit ran a webinar on 15 September on the opportunities, risks and conditions for using AI in healthcare, covering governance, data protection, cybersecurity and patient trust, for clinical, technical and management staff.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional health body debates how to adopt AI safely.
ai_news.significance_why: The Algarve's health unit serves the whole region.

ai_news.title: NERA and UAlg prepare two living labs to test robotics and AI on Algarve farms
ai_news.summary: The AGROBOTICS-DITWINS project will set up two living labs in the Algarve to test robotics and AI on working farms. 28 expressions of interest were received and the two hosts were still being selected. The Interreg SUDOE project runs until May 2028.
ai_news.ai_path: The living labs test AI and robotics in agriculture.
ai_news.significance_why: Two farms somewhere in the Algarve will host tests that other farms can learn from.

ai_news.title: Faro panel asks how AI decides which companies to recommend
ai_news.summary: Flow Productions, with Algarve STP and the Ireland Portugal Business Network, hosted an English-language panel on 22 July at the UAlg TEC Campus on how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity change online search, and on answer-engine and generative-engine optimisation.
ai_news.ai_path: The panel is about how AI assistants choose which businesses to recommend.
ai_news.significance_why: A Faro panel on AI search that firms in neighbouring councils can use.

ai_news.title: First Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP picks 12 companies, with AI adoption on the mentoring menu
ai_news.summary: AlgarveSTP's free mentoring programme chose 12 Algarve startups and SMEs. Only Bot Gonçalves is described as AI-based, using AI and satellite imagery to monitor critical infrastructure. Mentoring covers technology and AI adoption among other topics, and the programme is funded by ALGARVE 2030.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional accelerator cohort that includes an AI company and mentoring on AI adoption.
ai_news.significance_why: An accelerator for firms headquartered anywhere in the Algarve.

ai_news.title: Portimão uses AI to check building-permit documents
ai_news.summary: The Portimão council is rolling out a digital urban-management platform with an AI module that checks documents on submission and flags missing items. Town agent hint: this is a Portimão story that also matters region-wide.
ai_news.ai_path: A council deploys an AI module to check planning documents.
ai_news.significance_why: A council tool that adjacent councils may copy, though the service is Portimão's.

ai_news.title: Vilamoura school hosts an education summit on AI
ai_news.summary: The Colégio Internacional de Vilamoura held an Innovation in Education Summit on 9 May with panels on how AI affects teaching and learning.
ai_news.ai_path: A school summit centred on AI in education.

ai_news.title: UAlg wins 31.5 million euros for an AI-first European heritage centre
ai_news.summary: The University of Algarve's ICArEHB research centre secured 31.5 million euros, 15 million from Horizon Europe's Teaming for Excellence and 16.5 million national, to create UAlgTec Heritage. It takes an AI-first approach to protecting and studying archaeological heritage, with partners including Kiel University, ERA Arqueologia and Zartis, and expects over 70 skilled jobs in six years.
ai_news.ai_path: The centre's stated approach to heritage is AI-first.
ai_news.significance_why: The largest research award in the Algarve this year, with jobs and training across the region.

ai_news.title: Vale do Lobo launches Oliver, an AI digital concierge
ai_news.summary: The Loulé resort launched a multilingual AI concierge available around the clock for guests, owners and prospective buyers, including property recommendations. Town agent hint: Loulé.
ai_news.ai_path: A resort ships an AI product to customers.
ai_news.significance_why: A resort's own product, in Loulé.

ai_news.title: Turismo do Algarve runs free AI bootcamp for tourism professionals
ai_news.summary: As part of its Competências do Futuro Algarve programme, the regional tourism body scheduled a free four-hour AI session on 17 April at the Portimão hotel and tourism school covering ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, automation and prompting, plus a water-efficiency bootcamp.
ai_news.ai_path: The bootcamp teaches tourism staff to use AI tools.
ai_news.significance_why: The regional tourism body trains tourism staff across the Algarve.

ai_news.title: European funds to bring AI and robotics to 15 Algarve tourism firms, and a warning on agentic AI
ai_news.summary: At the first meeting of CCDR Algarve's tourism innovation platform, the president of Algarve Evolution urged companies to prepare for agentic AI that can search, compare and book on a traveller's behalf. An ALGARVE 2030 project will support 15 tourism SMEs with digital-maturity checks and AI and robotics action plans.
ai_news.ai_path: The story is about agentic AI in tourism and funded AI adoption.
ai_news.significance_why: A regionally funded programme and a warning aimed at the Algarve's whole tourism sector.

ai_news.title: AuroraMed and UAlg launch an executive course on AI in healthcare
ai_news.summary: AuroraMed, a Portuguese healthtech focused on AI in clinical management, and the University of Algarve's medical faculty launched an executive course in Faro on 20 April for health decision-makers, with PRR-funded scholarships.
ai_news.ai_path: A healthtech and a university teach AI in healthcare.
ai_news.significance_why: A course for health leaders of the whole region, backed by national funds.

ai_news.title: Algarve Evolution opens applications for its AI and robotics pilot for tourism SMEs
ai_news.summary: Part of INOVA ALGARVE 3.0, led by NERA with the university, the tourism body, CCDR Algarve, KIPT and Tertúlia Algarvia, the pilot offered consulting to 15 tourism firms. Applications ran from 20 February to 30 April 2026.
ai_news.ai_path: A funded programme to put AI and robotics into tourism firms.
ai_news.significance_why: A regionally funded pilot open to tourism firms across the Algarve.

ai_news.title: University of Algarve and Empowered Startups plan an AI cluster for the Algarve
ai_news.summary: Following the EPIA 2025 AI conference at the university, the two partners said they would link entrepreneurs, industry and higher education into an AI cluster and attract talent to southern Portugal.
ai_news.ai_path: The stated aim is a regional AI cluster.
ai_news.significance_why: A plan for an AI cluster for the whole region.

ai_news.title: EPIA 2025, Portugal's AI conference, is held at the University of Algarve in Faro
ai_news.summary: The 24th EPIA Conference on Artificial Intelligence ran from 1 to 3 October 2025 at the Gambelas campus, hosted by the University of Algarve with the Portuguese Association for AI as patron, with 16 tracks from AI in medicine and generative AI to AI and IoT in agriculture and AI in transport. A school on AI preceded it on 29 and 30 September.
ai_news.ai_path: It is a national AI research conference hosted in the region.
ai_news.significance_why: A national AI research conference, with the Portuguese AI association as patron.

ai_map.name: LeiGPT
ai_map.what: AI platform for lawyers on Portuguese law, registered in Faro and a member of Algarve Evolution, which its site lists with Google for Startups and Akamai among its partners and supporters. It answers legal research questions with citations to codes and court rulings, analyses documents, and runs as a cloud service or on a client's own servers. Available now, with a free one-day trial.
ai_map.ai_path: Its product is an AI assistant for legal work.

ai_map.name: Algarve Evolution
ai_map.what: Faro-based association of entrepreneurs, talent, startups, SMEs and partners that runs the Algarve Innovation Hub and incubator. It runs the regional AI adoption survey and the AI and robotics tourism programme, co-organised the Vibathon with Lovable, and its incubator takes technical founders building AI and software products.
ai_map.ai_path: It surveys AI adoption and runs AI and robotics programmes for regional firms.

ai_map.name: Algarve Digital Innovators
ai_map.what: Network of digital communities across the Algarve, supported by Algarve Evolution. Reported to include GDG Faro, Flutter Faro and Algarve AI Agents (our own newsroom's reading, to be re-checked at source).
ai_map.ai_path: The network includes AI and developer communities.

ai_map.name: Algarve AI Agents
ai_map.what: Community listed as AI-related in the Algarve entrepreneurship ecosystem directory and, per our newsroom, part of the Algarve Digital Innovators network. The directory gives no website: needs a primary source.
ai_map.ai_path: Its name says it is an AI agents community, and the BEALG directory lists it as AI-related.

ai_map.name: GDG Faro
ai_map.what: Developer community that organises DevFest Faro on 27 and 28 November 2026 on AI applications and agents. Its pages also list a Build with AI 2026 day on 11 April and a Gemma AI hackathon on 18 July at UALG TEC Campus, both still marked upcoming when read, so we cannot confirm they ran.
ai_map.ai_path: It runs a two-day conference on building AI applications.

ai_map.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg)
ai_map.what: Public university with campuses in Faro (Penha and Gambelas) and Portimão. Launched its AI use policy in September 2026, runs AI courses with partners, hosted the EPIA 2025 conference and leads UAlgTec Heritage.
ai_map.ai_path: It sets AI policy, teaches AI and hosts AI research.

ai_map.name: ICArEHB (UAlg research centre)
ai_map.what: UAlg research centre in archaeology and human behaviour evolution. It leads UAlgTec Heritage, which won 31.5 million euros to create UAlgTec Heritage, a European centre taking an AI-first approach to heritage. A presentation is listed for 17 November 2026 in Faro.
ai_map.ai_path: The new centre is described as AI-first.

ai_map.name: CEOT (Centro de Eletrónica, Optoelectrónica e Telecomunicações, UAlg)
ai_map.what: UAlg research centre that co-organised a 2024 workshop on deep learning for near-infrared chemometrics in food control.
ai_map.ai_path: It applies deep learning to spectroscopy data.

ai_map.name: CRIA (UAlg entrepreneurship and technology transfer division)
ai_map.what: UAlg division that runs the university's incubator and hosted the 10 November AI Lunch & Learn and, per our newsroom, the Vibathon opening.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosts AI events and supports spin-outs.

ai_map.name: FMCB-UAlg (Faculty of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences)
ai_map.what: Co-runs the executive course on AI in healthcare with AuroraMed, held in Faro.
ai_map.ai_path: It co-teaches an AI in healthcare course.

ai_map.name: AuroraMed
ai_map.what: Portuguese healthtech focused on AI in clinical management, partner of the UAlg healthcare AI executive course. The article does not say where it is based: location to confirm.
ai_map.ai_path: It sells AI for clinical management and trains health leaders.

ai_map.name: Empowered Startups
ai_map.what: Partner of UAlg in building an Algarve AI cluster and Platinum sponsor of the EPIA 2025 AI conference.
ai_map.ai_path: It backs a regional AI cluster.

ai_map.name: Lovable
ai_map.what: AI app-building company whose tool powered the sold-out Vibathon Algarve of 31 October 2026, co-organised with Algarve Evolution (per our newsroom).
ai_map.ai_path: Its AI tool was the core of the event.

ai_map.name: CCDR Algarve
ai_map.what: Regional coordination commission. Runs the regional smart-specialisation strategy and innovation platforms, co-funds the AI programmes through ALGARVE 2030 and is hosting a 24 November conference on digitalising the water cycle with AI.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosts AI in tourism platforms and AI-for-water events.

ai_map.name: NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve
ai_map.what: Regional business association based in Loulé. Leads INOVA ALGARVE 3.0, runs an AI Social Content Lab course in November 2026 and hosted the AI Lunch & Learn.
ai_map.ai_path: It leads an AI and robotics programme and trains firms in AI.

ai_map.name: Turismo do Algarve (Região de Turismo do Algarve)
ai_map.what: Regional tourism body that runs the Competências do Futuro Algarve programme, including a free AI bootcamp for tourism professionals, and is an INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 partner.
ai_map.ai_path: It trains tourism staff in AI tools.

ai_map.name: Algarve STP
ai_map.what: Named as partner of the July 2026 Faro AI search panel and as support for the UAlgTec Heritage presentation, and as promoter of the Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP, a free mentoring programme for 12 Algarve startups and SMEs funded by ALGARVE 2030. Its own site serves a bot challenge to automated readers, so its role is read through the press.
ai_map.ai_path: It runs a mentoring programme with AI adoption on the menu and co-hosts AI events.

ai_map.name: KIPT CoLab
ai_map.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.
ai_map.ai_path: It is a partner of the AI and robotics tourism programme.

ai_map.name: Tertúlia Algarvia
ai_map.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.
ai_map.ai_path: It is a partner of the AI and robotics tourism programme.

ai_map.name: ULS Algarve
ai_map.what: The regional health unit ran a webinar on AI in the national health service in September 2026 and is named in the AI healthcare course.
ai_map.ai_path: It trains staff on safe AI adoption in health.

ai_map.name: Flow Productions
ai_map.what: Creative technology agency with teams in Faro and Lisbon, listed as a member of Algarve Evolution (as Flow With Us). Its services include MarTech and AI, and its site says it helps companies get found by people and AI engines. It organised the July 2026 Faro panel on how AI assistants recommend businesses.
ai_map.ai_path: It sells MarTech and AI services and runs events on AI search visibility.

ai_map.name: Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub
ai_map.what: PRR-funded project (1.13 million euros, September 2023 to June 2026) to put an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network across six municipalities: Olhão, Alcoutim, Loulé, São Brás de Alportel, Tavira and Vila Real de Santo António. Town files name it in their own words.
ai_map.ai_path: It builds the sensor and data platform that municipal AI services would run on.

ai_map.name: Artificial Intelligence Algarve
ai_map.what: Community that appears as an 'AIA Artificial Intelligence Algarve' category on Algarve Evolution's events page and is listed as AI-related in the BEALG ecosystem directory. The events page showed no event under it when read. Needs its own public page.
ai_map.ai_path: Its name and the events category are about AI.

ai_map.name: Bot Gonçalves
ai_map.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that uses AI and satellite imagery to monitor critical infrastructure. The article gives no town: needs a primary source.
ai_map.ai_path: Its product is AI applied to satellite imagery.

ai_map.name: DigitalGTPro
ai_map.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that automates business processes and supports data-driven decisions. The article gives no town.
ai_map.ai_path: Process automation and data-driven decisions are the usual home of AI tools, and the article does not say it uses AI.

ai_map.name: AGROBOTICS-DITWINS
ai_map.what: Interreg SUDOE project led by the University of Málaga, with 13 partners from Spain, Portugal and France, building robotics, AI and digital-twin living labs for agriculture to May 2028. NERA and UAlg lead the Algarve pilot.
ai_map.ai_path: The project tests AI and robotics on farms.

ai_map.name: CIAC (UAlg research centre in arts and communication)
ai_map.what: UAlg centre that opened the INTERFACE digital translation lab in Faro in October 2026, with an AI Studio extension at its Santarém hub.
ai_map.ai_path: Its lab project includes an AI and digital literacy studio.

ai_map.name: INTREPIDA pro
ai_map.what: Cross-border Interreg Spain-Portugal project led by Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, with NERA as partner. It supported the 10 November Lunch & Learn on AI tools in Faro.
ai_map.ai_path: It runs sessions on using AI tools in business.

ai_map.name: Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia (FCT-UAlg)
ai_map.what: UAlg faculty named as the contact for EPIA 2025, the 24th Portuguese conference on AI, held at the Gambelas campus in Faro on 1 to 3 October 2025.
ai_map.ai_path: It hosted a national AI conference.

ai_map.name: AI Aumentar, Lda.
ai_map.what: Listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. The member page gives no description and links to concha-ai.com, a decision-intelligence product for leadership hiring, but that site does not mention AI Aumentar, so the link between them is unconfirmed. Needs its own source.
ai_map.ai_path: Its name points to AI, which is unconfirmed.

ai_map.name: DSPA (Data Science Portuguese Association)
ai_map.what: National association for data science and AI that is listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. Its own site lists a generative AI certification, an AI Act compliance programme for businesses, an AI agents day for executives and the annual INSIGHTS conference. The site states no Algarve link: it appears on the map because of the membership.
ai_map.ai_path: It is a national data science and AI association.

ai_map.name: ADJ3 Sistemas
ai_map.what: Faro web and app developer that builds sites and portals for universities and municipalities on Drupal and React, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its site lists AI services integrated with Drupal: chatbots that answer from a site's own content, smart search, and assistants for content editors.
ai_map.ai_path: It sells AI chatbots, search and editing assistants for public-interest websites.

ai_map.name: Neomarca
ai_map.what: SME consultancy operating since 1995 with its head office in Faro and a team in Porto, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its digital transformation work includes a service called digitalisation and adoption of artificial intelligence, alongside funding advice for programmes such as PRR and Portugal 2030.
ai_map.ai_path: It consults small firms on adopting AI tools and on the funding that pays for it.

extras.label: Regional programme ALGARVE 2030
extras.value: Reported on 10 November 2026 to have passed 50% of its funds committed. It co-funds the AI and robotics tourism programme.

extras.label: Starting a company here: free mentoring
extras.value: The Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP gave individual mentoring sessions to 12 Algarve startups and SMEs, including on AI adoption. It needed a headquarters in the Algarve and a validated business model. The first edition closed applications on 24 June 2026.

extras.label: Starting a company here: from research to a company
extras.value: UAlg's CRIA runs a proof-of-concept programme for early-stage firms and entrepreneurs from technology readiness level 3 to 6, co-funded by ALGARVE 2030. Its 2026 call closed on 10 July.

extras.label: Starting a company here: AI and robotics help for tourism firms
extras.value: Algarve Evolution's INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 pilot gave consulting and an action plan to 15 tourism SMEs, with a second wave of 5 published on its page. The call closed on 30 April 2026.

extras.label: Starting a company here: the regional funder
extras.value: ALGARVE 2030 is the regional programme that funds most of the support above. Its site lists information sessions for calls named MPr-2026-6 and Parcerias para a Inovação, with no company, digital or startup call open on the page when read.

extras.label: Starting a company here: the Algarve Evolution incubator
extras.value: Its Founder2Founder growth programme is a six-month mentor-led track for 8 companies that already have customers and revenue. An early-stage incubation programme for teams validating ideas, including technical founders building digital, AI or software products, is announced for 2027. The incubator page says Founder2Founder applications close on 30 September while the association's home page says they are closed: we have not resolved which is current.

extras.label: Starting a company here: the national start-up body
extras.value: Startup Portugal lists a national one-stop shop for founders, the RNi incubator network and the Tech Foundry Portugal deep-tech acceleration track. Its page lists no Algarve or AI programme.

extras.label: Starting a company here: the national government side
extras.value: IAPMEI's public pages list Espaço Empresa business support, the StartUP Voucher Innovate 2025-2026 and StartUP Boost programmes, StartUP Visa and Tech Visa for founders and tech workers, a national mentors network, and a network of Digital Innovation Hubs for digital transformation. Its funding pages list Portugal 2030 and PRR incentives, with open calls on its Concursos abertos page. The page names no AI programme and no Algarve-specific one. Its open-calls page is an index that points to the Portugal 2030 annual call plan (portugal2030.pt/plano-anual-de-avisos/) and the PRR call plan, which we have not read, with PRR digital transition lines under C16 Empresas 4.0.

extras.label: Funding calls planned: AI and innovation, and the Algarve's place in them
extras.value: Portugal 2030's annual call plan (September 2026 to August 2027, spreadsheet version of 14 September 2026) lists 177 planned calls worth about 2.04 billion euros. Only seven have a title or objective that mentions AI, digital or IT-type words, and none of the seven lists the Algarve. The one on AI is a national IAPMEI call for AI training for companies under COMPETE2030, worth 80 million euros, planned for 30 October to 30 December 2026, for Alentejo, Centro and Norte only. For the Algarve the spreadsheet has 16 ALGARVE2030 calls (the web page's filter showed 18). The business and innovation ones are SIAC Empreendedorismo Qualificado associado ao conhecimento (1 million euros, 30 September 2026 to 15 January 2027), SIAC Qualificação (500,000 euros, to 29 January 2027), SIAC Transferência do conhecimento científico e tecnológico and SIAC Descarbonização (500,000 euros each, 30 October 2026 to 26 February 2027), hiring of highly qualified staff by firms (1.5 million euros, 1 October 2026 to 30 June 2027) and SICE Inovação Produtiva (listed at zero). The national business R&D call SIID I&D Empresarial (40 million euros, 30 September to 31 December 2026) includes the Algarve. All are forecasts, not launched notices, and keyword matching on titles is a rough test.

gaps: Candidate for the map once an AI path is sourced: the Algarve cybersecurity competence centre (UAlg, NERA and the intermunicipal community AMAL), whose page does not mention AI.
Hint for the Portimão agent: the council's AI document check for building permits (3 July 2026), the Portimão hotel and tourism school (17 April AI bootcamp) and the StartUp Portimão incubator.
Hint for the Loulé agent: the Vale do Lobo AI concierge Oliver (16 April 2026), NERA's base, and Colégio Internacional de Vilamoura's AI summit (Vilamoura is in Loulé).
Hint for the Faro agent: UAlg Penha campus, UAlgTec Heritage, CRIA, DevFest Faro, Algarve Evolution and the ULS Algarve webinar all sit in Faro.

Dengun (a startup studio in the BEALG directory) returned 403, and Witflow (selected for Unicorn Factory Lisboa) is known only from a search result: both still need a source we can open before they go on the map.

The BEALG directory lists about 40 incubators and communities (ANJE Faro, QRIAR, GrowIN Portugal, Impact Hackers, Geek Sessions Faro and others) with no AI tag: each needs a look for an AI path before it is mapped.
Town files name the Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub in three different ways, so the region map shows it more than once: dev.places@ or the town agents could align the name.

Sul Informação and Jornal do Algarve serve their feeds but return 403 on article pages, and Postal and AlgarveSTP serve a bot challenge: we read only their feed headlines, so their AI stories are not in the news list. Headlines to open at source if a route is allowed: Algarve as the first Portuguese tourism destination to advertise on ChatGPT (Sul Informação, November 2026), the INTREPIDA AI Lab, an AI and tourism piece (September 2026), the Algarve Autodrome's AI-in-HR paper at the TMCT'26 conference in Portimão, and Jornal do Algarve's pieces on AI health diagnostics at home and on AI used for urban planning in Castro Marim.
Feeds read and working: Barlavento's AI tag, Sul Informação, Jornal do Algarve and Postal. None of the Algarve universities' or the CCDR's news pages gave a feed.
Barlavento's two AI items without a clear Algarve company (a national poll on AI instead of seeing a doctor, and a book on AI that includes an Olhão author) were left out as national or personal.

UAlg centres: CIMA's page lists marine monitoring and open-data projects but no AI, CCMAR's home page describes no AI beyond a DeepLabCut crash course in December, and CINTAL's page mentions no AI. The SEA-EU alliance lists developing its Green and AI Charters among its priorities (a July 2025 article), but we found no charter text.

Investment map: we found no 2026 funding round for an Algarve-founded AI startup. Leads whose articles we could not open: COREangels Algarve (an angel group), Sotavento Invest, the Dengun Founders Program (about 20 investor groups as partners) and INDICO Capital Partners.

Local media: Região Sul and Portugal Resident serve a Cloudflare challenge, Algarve Primeiro shows no feed, and Algarve Daily News gives an RSS address that returned an empty channel. A search shows Rádio Universitária do Algarve and a closed Rádio Solar Algarve, but we opened no radio page. Blogs and the town newspapers are not yet listed: the town agents' files hold some, and the region page should link them.

Algarve AI Agents and Artificial Intelligence Algarve have no public site we can read: their meetup listings sit on Luma and Meetup, which we do not read, and the second is LinkedIn only. We should ask Algarve Evolution for a public page, or for dates.

Algarve Evolution's members list (67 members over four pages, read in full) gives names only, and the member pages link to each firm's own site. Sites read with AI evidence, now mapped: LeiGPT, DSPA, Flow Productions, ADJ3 Sistemas and Neomarca. Sites read with none: QXote, Visualforma, Craft 4.0 (business intelligence and IoT), Cyberprotech (cybersecurity, Loulé), Sisgarbe (business software, Faro), Rolear (a Faro engineering and energy group), Azulchain (microcredentials) and Blackbird. Omnibees lists a chatbot called BeeAgent with no description, and the Host PMS site lists a separate AI product and a Canary integration but states no location. Not yet read: Canopy (403), Wise Rocket (404), Indrant and OSB Solutions (no site linked), We Sport IT, and the members not named here.
Hint for the Faro agent: LeiGPT, Flow Productions, ADJ3 Sistemas and Neomarca are Faro-based Algarve Evolution members with AI offers on their own sites, candidates for its map and a story.

Finding: in Portugal 2030's call plan none of the seven AI or digital calls includes the Algarve, and the national AI training call for companies (80 million euros) covers only Alentejo, Centro and Norte. The Algarve's own AI help so far comes from the INOVA ALGARVE 3.0 pilot and local bodies. We should check whether ALGARVE2030 plans an AI call of its own and read the formal notices once launched.

Starting a company here: the Algarve calls we found earlier have closed, and the plan lists new ALGARVE2030 calls opening from 30 September 2026. The formal notices, with eligibility and amounts, are not yet read, and the plan's budgets are forecasts.
Faro airport traffic for November, IPMA warning levels, algarve2030.gov.pt, amal.pt and ualg.pt were not opened on 16 November; the October airport figure seen in a search snippet is not verified.
Seen only as headlines: Olhão teachers on Erasmus+ AI and VR training (Postal, 5 November), and CCDR items of 26 October (Matéria Adentro, POCTEP 2021-2027, citrus innovation).

IPMA warnings for today could not be read: the ipma.pt warnings page the sub-agent tried returned a 404. Check ipma.pt directly. The CCDR notice of 11 November and its 24 November water conference were read from the list page only.
The Castro Marim dementia congress claim has now failed a second check: no official page shows it, and search found only the 2024 first edition. Treated as not true until a page we can open shows it.

algarve2030.gov.pt did not resolve from this session on 17 November, and ccdr-alg.pt had nothing dated 14 to 17 November. Seen only as headlines: ICCAT tuna meeting in Vilamoura (Barlavento), a housing march in Faro, a regional investment conference with 300 participants (Postal, 15 November), and national water-cut and E-REDES power-cut lists for 17 and 18 November (whether any of the five places is listed was not checked).
The UAlg page on its AI rules and principles is undated in the listing, so it is not used as news.

local_news.title: The University of Algarve hosts a conference on AI and water management on 24 November
local_news.summary: Third in the water-resources cycle of the Algarve 2030 programme with Público: AI to monitor consumption, find network losses and watch water quality; 14:00 to 18:00, Campus da Penha, Faro. The page gives no technical detail and no registration link.
local_news.ai_path: Sensors and consumption data from supply networks, then AI or analytics to find losses and anomalies, then operators act on them (the conference topics).

local_news.title: Storm Charles brought gusts near 100 km/h and flood risk to the Algarve on 11 November
local_news.summary: The interior minister said the worst period was about 15:00 to 19:00, with a high tide near 15:20. The article does not name the most affected municipalities.

local_news.title: CCDR Algarve closed its services on 11 November because of the declared alert
local_news.summary: The notice sits on the CCDR's news list; the notice itself was not opened.

local_news.summary: 3WX says it passed 300 sign-ups in its first hours; one outlet, uncorroborated, and the article does not mention AI.

local_news.title: CCDR Algarve's Matéria Adentro turns local cane, oyster shell and clay into products
local_news.summary: Results of creative residencies presented on 22 October in Faro: three cane insulation proposals and a modular rammed-earth bench. The roundtable named certification, sales and public procurement as the hurdles. Part of INOVA ALGARVE 3.0, co-financed by Algarve 2030.

local_news.title: CCDR Algarve presents the results of POCTEP 2021-2027 cross-border projects
local_news.summary: A session on 9 November at the CCDR auditorium for Algarve-led projects of the Spain-Portugal programme, to recognise beneficiaries and encourage networking.

local_news.title: IPMA has a yellow sea-agitation warning for the Algarve from 18 to 20 November
local_news.summary: Valid from 12:00 on 18 November to 02:00 on 20 November: northwest swells of 4 to 5 m on the western coast. All other Faro-district warnings were green when read on 17 November. Read from IPMA's open-data feed, which was summarised by the fetch tool, not read raw.

local_news.summary: About 2,000 trainees this year, mostly staff of AMAL and the Algarve councils; about 25,000 trained since 2003. The page does not mention AI.
